Benchmark Methodology & Mathematical Formulations

1. Dataset Partition & Reproducibility

A deterministic corpus of 20,000 synthetic transactions was generated with fixed PRNG seed 20260904 across 6 realistic Indian merchant verticals (Lenskart, boAt, Swiggy, Zomato, Nykaa, Urban Company). Partition split:

  • 70% Training / Calibration (14,000 transactions)
  • 15% Validation / Rule Tuning (3,000 transactions)
  • 15% Held-Out Test Set (5,000 transactions: txns[-5000:])

Both Naive Retry Baseline and RecoveryOS are evaluated simultaneously against the identical 5,000 held-out test records to guarantee mathematical fairness.

2. Mathematical Metric Definitions

  • Recovery Success Rate (%) = (Successful Verified Recoveries / Total Evaluated Failures) × 100
  • Net Recovered Revenue (₹) = ∑(Recovered Transaction Amounts) − Incurred Gateway Fees
  • Unnecessary Actions Burned = Total automated retry attempts dispatched on permanent/unrecoverable failures.
  • High-Risk Automated Actions = Retries erroneously executed on transactions with risk score > 0.35.
  • Estimated Gateway Fees Saved (₹) = (Permanent Halts + High-Risk Quarantines) × ₹3.50 (estimated gateway processing fee avoided per redundant attempt).
  • Net Economic Lift (₹) = RecoveryOS Recovered − Baseline Recovered + Gateway Fees Saved

3. Baseline Specification

Naive Retry: The status-quo industry approach of blindly retrying every failed transaction without failure categorization, risk checks, or customer CLV consideration. This causes high rate-limiting, wasted gateway processing fees, and severe chargeback risk.

4. Verification Command

To deterministically regenerate and verify the benchmark numbers locally:

python backend/app/data/synthetic_generator.py
python -m unittest discover backend/tests

RecoveryOS Architecture & Deterministic Safety Spec

Core Philosophy: Separation of Powers

"AI decides what might recover revenue. Deterministic policy decides what is safe. Execution happens only when approved."

The 6-Stage Execution Pipeline

  1. Event Ingestion: Ingests payment.failed webhook or checkout drop-off telemetry.
  2. AI Reasoning / Diagnosis: LLM/Classifier analyzes payment rail, failure code, customer CLV, and past decline patterns to produce an action recommendation and confidence score.
  3. Deterministic Policy Guardrails: Python rules engine rigorously validates all hard invariants. The AI cannot override these rules.
  4. Execution (Only If Approved): Razorpay Smart Retry or Payment Link issued with exponential jitter.
  5. Outcome Verification: Verifies capture status, halts upon consecutive failures, and records payment lifecycle.
  6. Audit Trail: Emits immutable, reproducible decision records with full rule telemetry.

Hard Deterministic Invariants

  • MAX_AUTO_RECOVERY_AMOUNT: Strictly ₹5,000.00. Transactions > ₹5k automatically route to Human Review.
  • MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS: Max 2 attempts. Prevents card network spam and fee burning.
  • MIN_AI_CONFIDENCE: 85% confidence floor. Any diagnosis < 0.85 requires human review.
  • FRAUD_RISK_BOUNDARY: Risk score > 0.35 is quarantined immediately.
  • PERMANENT_FAILURE_STOP: Instruments with CARD_EXPIRED, invalid credentials, or fraud blocks halt execution immediately (DO_NOTHING).
  • WEBHOOK_IDEMPOTENCY: In-memory/Redis signature hash table rejects replay attacks and duplicate event delivery.
  • ALREADY_CAPTURED_SAFETY: Payments marked captured are immediately suppressed from recovery.
